source: PREREG_V2_FROZEN.md §4 + §10 (approved by Pablo 2026-10-20 ~11:40 CDMX). Mechanical transcription; the document wins on disagreement. Power control changed to k = 6 after the scrambled-target pilot (Pablo 'B', 2026-10-20).
primary: p0 = p_self(phi) on the real targets, H_w at T2 under L_i^GCT, M = 1000 weight dithers, M' = 9999 reference dithers, ties against phi
non_confirmatory: v2 is a re-analysis of public data (statistic chosen after v1 results were public); any POSITIVE must carry that sentence

POSITIVE.condition: p0 <= 0.01 AND at least 2 of [V4, V8_1e-3, w003] give p <= 0.05 AND all validity controls pass

sub_label.ROBUST: V2 and V6 both give p > 0.10

NEGATIVE.mandatory_scope: excludes, at power >= 0.8, an effect in which phi hits at least 6 of the 8 informative rows through a real effect; weaker effects are not excluded

INVALID_if_any: v1 or v2 bundle hash mismatch
any rule, seed, dither law or size changed after freeze
control 2 (300 random bases, real targets, randomised p_self) KS p <= 0.01
control 3b (phi on 100 scrambles, randomised p_self) KS p <= 0.01
reference regression fails (one unit of the last displayed digit, D1 rule)
dual implementation of dither + p_self disagrees
any non-phi evaluation on the real targets before freeze
UNDERPOWERED_if: power of the k = 6 informative-row plant (50 plants, fraction with p_self <= 0.01) < 0.8
UNDERPOWERED_effect: POSITIVE may still be reported; NEGATIVE and INCONCLUSIVE may not relabel any row to Tier 4
NEGATIVE_consequence: even a valid, powered NEGATIVE supports only 'not distinguishable from numerology for strong effects' (Pablo decides any Tier 4 relabel)
report_only: p_cross (rank of p0 among control-2 p_self, 300 bases)
Z_S and p for S (21 rows)
Z_SF sign and p for S_F
lambda = 0.75 plant power (the design's original power control, demoted after the pilot)
